title: Mahj Mondays at the Gillioz
description: Mahj Mondays at the Gillioz is scheduled for Monday, November 16, 2026 at 5:30 PM CST at The Gallery at the Gillioz Theatre, 325 Park Central E., Springfield. The Gallery at the Gillioz in collaboration with Blooming Bams is the organizer. Admission is free.
venue: The Gallery at the Gillioz Theatre
